repository.name: @webex/plugin-meetings

plugin-meetings-sdk.summary: Published npm package @webex/plugin-meetings. main is dist/index.js and types dist/types/index.d.ts, both built from src/index.ts, whose named exports (Meeting, CONSTANTS, REACTIONS, MeetingInfoV2, error classes, RemoteMedia, TriggerProxy, getAIEnablementApprover, media-helper stream factories and types) are the package API.

meetings-plugin.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/index.ts. Importing the package calls registerPlugin('meetings', Meetings, {config, interceptors}) from @webex/webex-core, which mounts webex.meetings with the defaults in src/config.ts and installs the LocusRetryStatusInterceptor, LocusRouteTokenInterceptor and DataChannelAuthTokenInterceptor request interceptors.

meetings-collection-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/meetings/index.ts. The Meetings plugin class: device and Mercury register/unregister, meeting create and collection lookup, sync of active meetings, reachability start, site preference fetch (fetchSitePreferencesMeViaSite), personal meeting room access, and the meetings:* events.

meeting-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/meeting/index.ts. The Meeting class: join, leave and end, media add/update/stop, mute, share, lock, host and recording controls, feature controller accessors, Locus state application, and the meeting:*, media:* and network:* events it emits.

meetings-events.summary: In-process event names declared in src/constants.ts: EVENT_TRIGGERS plus the BREAKOUTS.EVENTS, INTERPRETATION.EVENTS and AI_ENABLE_REQUEST.EVENTS families, the annotation event constants, and the reachability:* literals emitted by src/reachability/index.ts. Owned here because src/meeting emits most of them; they are emitted through TriggerProxy or the emitter on the Meetings, Meeting, Members, Breakouts, Interpretation, AI enable request, annotation and reachability scopes.

meeting-info-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/meeting-info/meeting-info-v2.ts. MeetingInfoV2 (exported as a namespace), the MeetingInfoUtil export, and the meeting-info error classes: destination resolution to meeting metadata, password, captcha and policy failure branches.

members-api.summary: Not a named export of src/index.ts; consumers reach it through Meeting (meeting.members) in the published package (package.json); owned by src/members/index.ts. Members collection on a Meeting: roster projection, add/remove/admit/mute/raise-hand/role mutations, and the members:* events.

member-model.summary: Not a named export of src/index.ts; consumers reach it through Meeting (meeting.members) in the published package (package.json); owned by src/member/index.ts. Member model for one participant: identity, status, media, role and device properties derived from a Locus participant.

remote-media-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/multistream/remoteMedia.ts. RemoteMedia (exported) plus the multistream remote media manager, groups, receive and send slot managers, and media request arbitration that back multistream layouts.

breakouts-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/breakouts/index.ts. meeting.breakouts: breakout session collection and state, attendee and host operations (start, end, assign, broadcast, ask for help, return to main), edit lock, and the BREAKOUTS.EVENTS family.

interpretation-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/interpretation/index.ts. meeting.simultaneousInterpretation: language subscriptions, interpreter management, direction and handoff requests, and the INTERPRETATION.EVENTS family.

annotation-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/annotation/index.ts. meeting.annotation: live annotation start, stop and approval, command and stroke relay over the LLM data channel, and annotation events; payload types in src/annotation/annotation.types.ts.

ai-enable-request-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/aiEnableRequest/index.ts. meeting.aiEnableRequest: AI assistant enablement request, accept and decline, plus getAIEnablementApprover (exported) for approver selection.

webinar-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/webinar/index.ts. meeting.webinar: webinar panelist and attendee operations, practice session, webcast and role state.

recording-controller-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/recording-controller/index.ts. Recording controller used by Meeting to start, stop, pause and resume recording: through the recording service (PUT <serviceUrl>/loci/<locusId>/recording) when a service URL is set, otherwise through Locus controls.

controls-options-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/controls-options-manager/index.ts. Controls options manager used by Meeting to set mute-on-entry, disallow-unmute, view-participant-list and related meeting control options.

personal-meeting-room-api.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/personal-meeting-room/index.ts. webex.meetings.personalMeetingRoom: retrieve and claim the user personal meeting room.

reactions-catalog.summary: Reached through the published package (package.json); owned by src/reactions/reactions.ts. REACTIONS (exported namespace) and the Reaction type: reaction and skin-tone catalogs used to send and normalize in-meeting reactions.

locus-http.summary: Client of the Webex Locus REST service. MeetingRequest builds the Locus participant, media, control and share requests that Meeting and its controllers send through webex.request; route construction stays in the request classes.

site-preferences-http.summary: MeetingRequest for the Meetings plugin: active-meeting sync, geo hint, and the site /wbxappapi/v1/users/me/preference request behind fetchSitePreferencesMeViaSite.

meeting-info-http.summary: Requests to the Webex meeting-info service that resolve a destination (SIP, personal room, conversation, Locus URL, meeting link) to meeting metadata.

roap-signaling.summary: ROAP offer, answer, ok and error messages sent to Locus media endpoints, and the TURN discovery exchange in src/roap/turnDiscovery.ts.

locus-info-projection.summary: LocusInfo: applies Locus full state, deltas and hash-tree datasets to one client projection and emits scoped change callbacks consumed by Meeting and Members.

hash-tree-sync.summary: HashTreeParser: reconciles incremental Locus datasets by hash comparison, fetches missing leaves, and reports typed updates to LocusInfo.

media-connection.summary: Media utilities that build internal-media-core connections, hold media properties, and await connection readiness (MediaConnectionAwaiter).

reachability-service.summary: Reachability: probes media clusters over UDP, TCP and TLS, records NAT type, and reports results used in join requests and metrics.

reconnection-manager.summary: ReconnectionManager: bounded media reconnect, rejoin and network-change recovery for one Meeting, with reconnection events.

locus-interceptors.summary: Request interceptors for Locus retry-after handling, Locus route tokens, and LLM data-channel auth token refresh.

meetings-metrics.summary: Behavioral metrics helper that submits meeting telemetry through webex.internal.metrics with the names in src/metrics/constants.ts.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin, WebexPlugin and StatelessWebexPlugin base classes, webex.request, service catalog and interceptor pipeline hosting the meetings plugin.

internal-plugin-device-registration.summary: webex.internal.device register and unregister, device URL and feature toggles used during Meetings registration.

internal-plugin-mercury-events.summary: webex.internal.mercury connect, disconnect and event:locus deliveries that feed meeting state.

internal-plugin-metrics-api.summary: webex.internal.newMetrics (submitClientEvent, submitInternalEvent, submitMQE, callDiagnosticLatencies, callDiagnosticMetrics) for call analyzer telemetry, and webex.internal.metrics.submitClientMetrics for the behavioral metrics sent by src/metrics/index.ts.

internal-media-core.summary: WebRTC media connection, multistream and ROAP primitives used by media, multistream and roap.

media-helpers-streams.summary: Local camera, microphone and display stream classes and factories re-exported from src/index.ts.

internal-plugin-llm-channel.summary: LLM data channel connections used for annotation relay, captions and in-meeting AI features.

internal-plugin-voicea-transcription.summary: Voicea transcription and caption service used by Meeting transcription features.

browser-webrtc.source: W3C WebRTC and Media Capture APIs (browser)
browser-webrtc.summary: RTCPeerConnection and media device APIs used for reachability probes and media connections.

module_docs_decision.reason: Migration moves each src/<module>/ai-docs/<name>-spec.md to the source-local default src/<module>/docs/README.md; no src/*/docs folder existed, so there is no collision. test:style lints ./src/**/*.* and the shared legacy eslint ignore patterns exclude Markdown; build:src compiles -js -ts only, so Markdown under src/ does not enter dist/.

repo_context_decision.reason: Neither the operational context nor its schema existed in this package; the context is created from package evidence and the migrated glossary.

artifact_decisions.reason: Library package, not a deployable service: package.json has no start script, container, or deployment descriptor.
No package-level documentation site exists; documentation publishing stays with the workspace.

The package serves no HTTP routes. Its HTTP contracts are internal clients of Webex services (locus-http, site-preferences-http, meeting-info-http, roap-signaling); the published surface is the npm export described by plugin-meetings-sdk.
The workspace owns security policy; security architecture is described in docs/architecture.md.
Contribution instructions are owned at the workspace root CONTRIBUTING.md.
Changelog generation is owned at the workspace root; this package has no changelog file.
The CTO readiness checklist applies to deployable services; this package is a library.

consumed: @webex/legacy-tools build and test runner via package.json
retained README.md, UPGRADING.md, internal-README.md and feature READMEs (context only)
Repo Standards templates at the monorepo root .sdd/templates/repo-standards, referred to through layout.monorepo_package.templates_root_path (this package holds no templates)
